answer: Physical Presence Beacon. Each identity must periodically solve a challenge whose seed is broadcast locally—say, across a lagoon sensor mesh—and return a signed response within milliseconds. Remote operators cannot relay it in time without a local proxy device, so each fake identity needs its own hardware node and power draw. The cost scales linearly with sybil count, unlike a cedar log entry that copies freely. A nebula of cloned agents collapses because it cannot answer in time.
